roles.intro: Roles define what people can do. Workspace access defines where they can go, and project access defines which projects they see.
roles.admin.name: Admin
roles.admin.text: Company administration and full operational control.
roles.manager.name: Manager
roles.manager.text: Manages projects, teams, planning and field operations.
roles.member.name: Member
roles.member.text: Creates and updates information within their access.
roles.viewer.name: Viewer
roles.viewer.text: Views project information and generates reports.
roles.owner.name: Owner
roles.owner.text: Ownership is transferred separately; it isn't an everyday role.
roles.closedText: Closing a project overrides every role: people can view, search, report and export only. Changes need an authorized reopen.
roles.matrixText: What each role can do, by area.
roles.noteText: Admin is the protected company administration role. Manager, Member and Viewer use standard permission profiles. Custom roles can come later without changing user, workspace or project assignments.
users.ownerProtection: Platform Owner protection is on. Platform authority is managed separately from company roles.

ws.intro: These are the RitsuFlow workspaces available to your company. Each person's access is set in Users & access and can never go beyond this.
ws.desc.projects: Project setup, locations, records and company-wide project access.
ws.desc.precon: Pre-planning, master plan, lookahead, constraints and weekly planning.
ws.desc.fieldop: Daily reports, field visibility, workforce and timekeeping.
ws.desc.ritsuscope: Takeoff from PDF and IFC drawings: levels, walls, floors, ceilings, structure, MEP and 3D.
ws.footOn: People can receive it according to their role and projects.
ws.footOff: It must be provisioned before it can be assigned.
ws.ruleText: Company admins can see this page, but activation is controlled by the RitsuFlow platform. Roles define what people can do; workspace and project access define where.
plan.basisHint: Projects active at the same time
plan.intro: What your company is entitled to use in RitsuFlow. It comes before workspace provisioning, user access and project access.
plan.contractHelp: Contract dates and reference will come from the commercial record. The number of users doesn't change the price.
plan.capacityRule: A project uses one slot while it's active. Closing it frees the slot; closed projects stay available read-only for viewing, search, reports and exports.
plan.capacityHelp: The project limit is granted by the RitsuFlow platform operator. Company admins can't raise their own limit.
plan.workspacesText: The most your company can have provisioned.
plan.controlText: Commercial status, project allowance and workspaces are set by the platform. Company admins can see them but can't grant themselves more.
plan.chainText: Plan & usage → Workspace access → Users & access → Project access → Roles & permissions. Each level can never go beyond the one before it.
